description: The pie chart titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)” visually represents the distribution of token routing within the Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Models framework, showing how tokens are routed across different components. The chart is divided into three segments: a large green section labeled “LOCAL” occupying 94.5% of the chart, a smaller red section labeled “LLM” at 3.9%, and a very small blue section labeled “EDGE_P2P” at 1.6%. The chart does not include a legend, but the labels are positioned near their respective slices. The percentages are explicitly labeled within each corresponding slice. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with the largest slice (LOCAL) positioned at the bottom right, followed by LLM and then EDGE_P2P, which is the smallest and appears to be slightly exploded or offset from the rest of the pie for emphasis.
